import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 205;
    static final int MAX_M = MAX_N * MAX_N;
    
    static int[] prev_edge = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] visited = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] src = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] cap = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] dst = new int[MAX_M];
    static int edge_count = 0;
    
    static int[][] A = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] B = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] red = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] blocked = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    
    static int[][] dist = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int counter;
    static int[] dist_red = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] seen_bfs = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[][] queue = new int[MAX_N][2];
    
    static final int[] dX = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static final int[] dY = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    
    static void connect(int u, int v, int uv, int vu) {
        src[edge_count] = u;
        dst[edge_count] = v;
        cap[edge_count] = uv;
        prev_edge[edge_count] = head[u];
        head[u] = edge_count++;
        
        src[edge_count] = v;
        dst[edge_count] = u;
        cap[edge_count] = vu;
        prev_edge[edge_count] = head[v];
        head[v] = edge_count++;
    }
    
    static int augment(int v, int t, int f) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        if (visited[v]++ != 0) return 0;
        for (int e = head[v]; e != -1; e = prev_edge[e]) {
            if (cap[e] > 0) {
                int u = dst[e];
                int flow = augment(u, t, Math.min(f, cap[e]));
                if (flow > 0) {
                    cap[e] -= flow;
                    cap[e ^ 1] += flow;
                    return flow;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int flow(int s, int t) {
        int total = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
            int delta = augment(s, t, 2000000000);
            total += delta;
            if (delta == 0) break;
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], 63);
            dist[i][i] = 0;
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c == 'Y') blocked[x][y] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z') red[x][y] = 1;
                else A[x][y] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    B[x][y] = c - '0';
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + dX[d];
                        int ny = y + dY[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                            blocked[nx][ny] == 0 && red[nx][ny] == 0) {
                            dist[x * n + y][nx * n + ny] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int N = n * n;
        for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    if (dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] < dist[i][j]) {
                        dist[i][j] = dist[i][k] + dist[k][j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int qh = 0, qt = 0;
        Arrays.fill(dist_red, 63);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red[i][j] == 1) {
                    queue[qt][0] = i;
                    queue[qt][1] = j;
                    qt++;
                    dist_red[i * n + j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (qh != qt) {
            int x = queue[qh][0];
            int y = queue[qh][1];
            qh++;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dX[d];
                int ny = y + dY[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                    blocked[nx][ny] == 0 && red[nx][ny] == 0 && 
                    dist_red[nx * n + ny] > 1e9) {
                    dist_red[nx * n + ny] = dist_red[x * n + y] + 1;
                    queue[qt][0] = nx;
                    queue[qt][1] = ny;
                    qt++;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int sink = MAX_N - 1;
        int source = MAX_N - 2;
        
        for (int start = 0; start < N; start++) {
            Arrays.fill(seen_bfs, 0);
            qh = 0;
            qt = 0;
            int sx = start / n;
            int sy = start % n;
            if (blocked[sx][sy] == 1 || red[sx][sy] == 1) continue;
            
            queue[qt][0] = sx;
            queue[qt][1] = sy;
            qt++;
            seen_bfs[start] = 1;
            
            while (qh != qt) {
                int x = queue[qh][0];
                int y = queue[qh][1];
                qh++;
                
                if (dist[start][x * n + y] <= T) {
                    connect(start << 1, (x * n + y) << 1 | 1, 1000, 0);
                }
                
                if (dist[start][x * n + y] == dist_red[x * n + y]) continue;
                
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nx = x + dX[d];
                    int ny = y + dY[d];
                    int nid = nx * n + ny;
                    if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                        blocked[nx][ny] == 0 && red[nx][ny] == 0 && 
                        dist[start][nid] <= dist_red[nid] && 
                        dist[start][nid] <= T && 
                        dist[start][nid] > dist[start][x * n + y] && 
                        seen_bfs[nid] == 0) {
                        queue[qt][0] = nx;
                        queue[qt][1] = ny;
                        qt++;
                        seen_bfs[nid] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            connect(source, i << 1, A[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            connect((i << 1) | 1, sink, B[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        
        System.out.println(flow(source, sink));
    }
}
